data.narrative:
Anthrogen is a Seed-stage biotech company founded by Ankit Singhal, Connor Lee, and Vignesh Karthik that has raised $4M to date. The valuation assessment draws from a sector universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in Biotech & Health, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Of the three valuation methods examined, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. This method uses Anthrogen's $4M total raised as a base proxy and applies a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x, yielding an implied valuation of $10M. Peer-Median comparison was not viable due to insufficient narrow-stage peers in the dataset (0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage peers meeting screening criteria); while 7 same-sector peers exist, none clustered sufficiently to produce reliable median statistics. Public-Comp Anchoring could not be applied because Anthrogen does not disclose revenue; the 3-company public median P/S of 8.1x cannot be deployed without this input.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $8M to $12M, with a median point of $10M. The narrow methodological foundation—relying on a single step-up multiplier rather than triangulated cross-checks—represents the primary uncertainty. Revenue disclosure or identification of additional early-stage private peer transactions would materially strengthen conviction in this range.
